headline: India Offers Up to 50% Funding for Deepwater Oil and Gas Wells
summary: India's Samudra Manthan initiative will fund up to 50% of deepwater well costs, with financial assistance to be recovered from commercial profits under strict eligibility criteria.
why: Government subsidies for offshore exploration aim to boost domestic hydrocarbon production and reduce import dependency for energy-consuming nations.

impacts.name: Energy Exploration
impacts.why: State-backed funding for high-risk offshore exploration reduces capital barriers and financial exposure for energy companies drilling deepwater wells.
